scenes.say: Ever wonder how FastAPI checks your data and routes requests so reliably? Let’s break down its secret sauce.

scenes.label: Decorators
scenes.sub: Routes use decorators to map HTTP methods.
scenes.say: FastAPI uses decorators to connect functions to endpoints. You can handle GET or POST requests with a simple annotation.
Here, a Pydantic model called Item defines the expected data. FastAPI checks incoming requests against this model automatically.
This approach gives you instant error messages, leverages Python type hints, and keeps your API docs up to date.

scenes.question: What happens if you skip Pydantic?
scenes.right: Without Pydantic, FastAPI won’t check or serialize incoming data. You lose automatic validation.
scenes.say: Don’t forget: if you skip Pydantic models, FastAPI won’t validate your data. That’s an easy mistake in interviews.
